Select count(distinct Cust_Cd)  as count from NESZ_DIM.EXT_Customer_Hier  where etl_src ='MDM_CST_HIE_MST_MV'

WITH maxdt as(
  select *
  from dbo.RSF
  where sorperiod = FORMAT(GetDate(),'yyyyMM')
),
sorperiod_dt as(
  SELECT sorperiod,RSF_Source,PubDate
  FROM
    (SELECT sorperiod,RSF_Source,PubDate,row_number() over (partition by sorperiod,RSF_Source order by PubDate desc)sorperiod_rank
    FROM maxdt)tmp
    --dscc.DW2SAP_RSF_L1)tmp
  WHERE sorperiod_rank=1
)
select sum(Amount) from maxdt  t1 inner join sorperiod_dt t2 
on
t1.sorperiod=t2.sorperiod AND t1.PubDate=t2.PubDate 
 AND t1.RSF_Source=t2.RSF_Source
